Hi Samira —

Appreciate the timeline. Per your request, attaching the items that directly address the IAM sections of the questionnaire: 

Attachments in this message:
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary of controls and scope)
- redwood-iam-saml-metadata.xml (IdP/SP metadata sample)
- redwood-scim-api-docs.pdf (SCIM 2.0 endpoints, supported attributes, rate limits)
- sso-integration-guide.pdf (quick checklist for IdP teams)

Short answers to your SCIM/SAML/RBAC questions: 
- SAML: we support SAML 2.0, HTTP-POST/Redirect bindings, SHA-256 signing. We expose a stable ACS URL and entityID per customer (sample in attached XML). NameID supports email and persistent formats.
- SCIM: SCIM 2.0 supported. PATCH and PUT supported; PATCH follows RFC 7644 semantics. We support incremental provisioning and bulk operations for initial syncs. Typical rate limit is 100 req/min for provisioning endpoints (can be adjusted for dedicated customers).
- RBAC & admin controls: role hierarchy (Org Admin, Billing Admin, Engineer, Read-only), MFA required for Org Admins, RBAC changes are audited and retained for 1 year by default (longer retention available as an add-on). Service accounts require explicit approval; we enforce least privilege by default.

I’ve also taken the vendor questionnaire and started filling the IAM sections — see the attached redwood answers in the file we’ll return. Aditya, Neha — can you validate the SCIM attribute map and confirm rate-limit defaults?

Proposed tech deep-dive: Oct 6 at 10:00 AM PST (30 minutes). Samira, does that work? If yes I’ll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda: SAML metadata exchange, SCIM test user provisioning, and acceptance criteria for provisioning.

Best,
Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Samira / Marissa —

Quick tech notes ahead of the Oct 6 deep-dive: 
- SAML metadata: our sample uses SHA-256 for signing; ACS URL in sample is https://app.redwood.com/saml/acs/ceres-<org-id>. We support email and persistent NameID formats.
- SCIM: we implement SCIM 2.0, support PATCH (RFC 7644) and bulk operations via /scim/v2/Bulk. Default rate limit is 100 req/min; we can temporarily raise to 500 req/min for initial syncs with coordination.
- RBAC: Org Admin role can create other admins; we require MFA for Org Admins and logging is shipped to customer-specific audit logs (retained 1 year by default).
- Test accounts: for provisioning tests we can provide a sandbox tenant and a test service account with scoped rights — let me know preferred usernames.

I filed a quick ticket for the testing checklist: JIRA IAM-123 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/IAM-123).

See you on Oct 6 — I’ll bring the SCIM attribute mapping and a short Postman collection for provisioning tests.
